messages_kind_reference_check.name: messages_kind_reference_check
messages_kind_reference_check.value: ("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND "messages"."server_invitation_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."call_conversation_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'server_invite' AND "messages"."call_conversation_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'call_invite' AND "messages"."server_invitation_id" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'dm_call' AND "messages"."server_invitation_id" IS NULL AND "messages"."call_conversation_id" IS NULL)

notifications_kind_reference_check.name: notifications_kind_reference_check
notifications_kind_reference_check.value:
("notifications"."kind" IN ('friend_request','friend_accepted') AND "notifications"."friendship_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."server_invitation_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."message_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("notifications"."kind" = 'server_invitation' AND "notifications"."server_invitation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."friendship_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."message_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("notifications"."kind" = 'mention' AND "notifications"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."friendship_id" IS NULL AND "notifications"."server_invitation_id" IS NULL)
